description: So...it's been an eventful few weeks from Riyadh's perspective which I think makes it time to finally take a look at the Kingdom and its military. And so amidst the fighting in Yemen, the attack on the East-West pipeline and reported attacks against Riyadh itself, let's talk about the military Saudi Arabia has built.
